COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
CLCON No. 350 of 2021
Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Heard Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, 
Advocate for the petitioner. 
It is alleged that opposite party has
wilfully disobeyed the order dated 
09.03.2021 passed in WPSS No. 246 of 
2021.
Issue notice to opposite party
calling upon him to file his response to 
the allegations made in the contempt 
petition.
List this matter after four weeks.
(Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) 16.08.2021
Navin

counsel for the petitioner.
Mr. D.S. Patni, the learned Senior 
Advocate assisted by Mr. B.S. Bisht, the

make good for the rest of the amount.

In the meantime, rest of the order 
passed by the Court be complied.
